verdict.rationale: The evidence documents screening configurations: you can create multiple configurations, choose screening lists, and review hits and alerts. None of it mentions name-matching settings such as fuzziness or thresholds, nor any way to inspect alias or transliteration matches. Screening-list selection is an adjacent control, not configurable name matching, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can configure name matching and inspect alias or transliteration matches
